summary: The implementation covers most frontend and backend requirements. Backend includes device management, sensor readings, automation rules, alerts, and recommendations. Frontend provides dashboard, device management, automation rules, analytics, alerts, and AI recommendations views. Role-based access control is implemented. Design system follows mint green and slate gray color scheme. However, some specific features may have gaps in the visible diff due to truncation.
